Post-harvest technology
The early crop is to be threshed within a day or two after harvest otherwise there would be fermentation and discoloration of grains. Reduce the moisture content of grains to 14% by drying. Pedal operated and power operated thresher should be used for threshing. Hand operated winnower should be used for cleaning the grains. Power operated thresher-cumwinnower should be used for simultaneous threshing and cleaning of the grains.
